title: Callvale after: one shared file system
claim: All web instances and conversion workers mount one Amazon EFS file system through a mount target in each Availability Zone.
alt: After: the web instances in three zones and the conversion workers mount one Amazon EFS file system through a mount target in each zone.

edges.label: same zone
edges.say: Each instance connects through the mount target within the same Availability Zone.
Every web instance and every worker mounts one Amazon EFS file system.
A report that one web instance writes can be downloaded from any web instance.
